# Awesome Checklists

> A living reference library of practical review checklists for software and AI products. Use the checklists to identify gaps, verify work, and support evidence-based decisions.

Website: https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/
Source: https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/awesome-checklists

## Important limitations

This collection is a reference, not the definitive or exhaustive source of truth. It does not confer certification or guarantee security, reliability, compliance, accessibility, AI safety, or launch readiness. Select applicable checks based on project context, risk, and jurisdiction; verify important facts against current primary sources. Suggestions, corrections, and contributions are encouraged.

## Start here

- [Overview and how to use](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/): Purpose, workflow, important warnings, and contribution guidance.
- [Contributor and AI-agent guide](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/AGENTS.html): Scope ownership, stable checklist IDs, and repository maintenance conventions.

## Shared checklists

- [01 — Requirements and Planning Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/01_Requirements_and_Planning.html): Verify that the project solves a validated problem, has measurable goals, clear scope, testable requirements, realistic delivery plans, and defined API/frontend requirements.
- [02 — Legal Issues Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/02_LegalIssues.html): Identify legal, licensing, contractual, privacy, and regulatory questions early. This is an issue-spotting tool, not legal advice or a certification of compliance.
- [03 — Architecture and Code Quality Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/03_Architecture_and_CodeQuality.html): Review design trade-offs, system boundaries, maintainable code, engineering reviews, decision records, and API/frontend architecture. This checklist evaluates structure and evolvability; it 
- [04 — Internationalization and Localization Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/04_Internationalization_and_Localization.html): Verify that supported languages, writing systems, locales, and markets have functional and comprehensible end-to-end experiences. Internationalization makes a system adaptable; localization 
- [05 — Security Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/05_Security.html): Assess confidentiality, integrity, availability, abuse resistance, and operational security proportionate to project risk.
- [06 — Cost and FinOps Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/06_Cost_and_FinOps.html): Verify that technology spending is attributable, visible, forecastable, and optimized for business value without compromising required quality, reliability, security, or user outcomes. FinOp
- [07 — Documentation and Developer Experience Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/07_Documentation_and_DeveloperExperience.html): Verify that developers and operators can find accurate information, reproduce their local environment, understand API and system behavior, make changes safely, and maintain the product witho
- [08 — Testing Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/08_Testing.html): Verify expected functionality, quality, reliability, and release readiness using reproducible evidence.
- [09 — Performance and Scalability Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/09_Performance_and_Scalability.html): Verify that priority user experiences and services meet documented latency, throughput, capacity, and efficiency objectives at realistic demand. Separate browser metrics from backend metrics
- [10 — Reliability and Disaster Recovery Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/10_Reliability_and_DisasterRecovery.html): Verify that critical user journeys remain usable under expected failures and can recover within agreed downtime and data-loss targets. Reliability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and bus
- [11 — DevOps and CI/CD Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/11_DevOps_and_CI_CD.html): Verify repeatable builds, trusted deployment artifacts, controlled infrastructure changes, safe rollout and rollback, and accountable software delivery. This checklist focuses on delivery sy
- [12 — Monitoring and Observability Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/12_Monitoring_and_Observability.html): Verify that critical services and user journeys can be understood through trustworthy telemetry, actionable alerts, service-level measurements, and effective incident investigation. Monitori
- [13 — Analytics and Product Metrics Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/13_Analytics_and_ProductMetrics.html): Verify that product metrics answer meaningful decisions and are built on well-defined events, trustworthy data, privacy-aware collection, and sound experimentation. This template does not ce
- [14 — Release and Launch Readiness Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/14_Release_and_LaunchReadiness.html): Verify that a new product, service, or significant change is ready for controlled customer exposure, has an explicit go/no-go decision, and can be operated and supported safely after launch.

This focus
- [05 — Accessibility Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/frontend/05_Accessibility.html): Verify that essential product experiences are perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for people using a range of input methods and assistive technologies. The intended standard an

- [14 — GEO and AEO Checklist](https://pro-genai.github.io/awesome-checklists/frontend/14_GEO_and_AEO.html): Improve how clearly and reliably a project can be understood, sourced, and answered by search answer systems and generative AI. GEO = Generative Engine Optimization; AEO = Answer Engine Opti
